method: Read-only SQLite TASK.modelId=49. Every globalTaskId repeats exactly 12 times; assign its sorted occurrences to replay 0..11. Join COMPUTE_TASK_INFO for names/shapes. Durations are arithmetic summed kernel durations, not critical path or attribution; streams overlap. Do not add hcom and AivKernel: they represent the same HCCL task. Profile is from September 30; no new full-model run was performed.
activation_semantics: Old profile has ordinary npu::npu_swiglu/aclnnSwiGlu API during real prefill; captured SwiGlu has only attr_0:-1. No npu_clipped_swiglu API and no 48x2048/48x4096 Clamp kernels. A positive routed clamp limit is not demonstrated. 8x256 clamp kernels belong to the TP-sharded shared expert activation.
